Music Generator HD 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generate HD music for videos using text or mood prompts, with support for MP4, MOV, WAV, and MP3 files up to 200MB.
- Fast cloud-based processing (30-60 seconds) outputs 1080p MP4 files for creators.
- Automatic setup handles token management and session creation; notifies user when ready.
- Supports uploads, music generation, timeline previews, export, credit checking, and status reporting.
- Clear mapping of user intents to backend actions and robust error handling.
- Works well for quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
